description:
The gentle dance of snowflakes as they fall to the ground. Sparkling lights twinkling in the frigid night air. Couples holding hands and sharing in joyous laughter. While most people anticipate the Christmas season, for Noel Alan Brown it is nothing but an inevitable annual annoyance. Making his way through the gaudy streets of New York in pursuit of some semblance of enjoyment, he arrives at a club and meets Lee June: mysterious, seductive, and utterly irresistible. But after a night of intensely playful passion, June is nowhere to be seen…leaving nothing but another reason to add to Noel's Christmas hate list. Returning his focus to a crucial upcoming presentation, Noel tries his best to erase the alluring June from his mind to no avail. Luckily for him, he’ll have a chance to see his disappearing lover again - because June is working for the competition! Tensions won’t be the only thing rising as the two go at it in both the board room and the bedroom.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*
